member.name: T:Mfr.Engine.CommitPlanner
member.summary: Builds an ordered commit plan that respects ancestor/descendant containment, path-shift chains, and cycles.

remarks.para: The planner only considers items in state with actual preview changes. Items that have no preview changes are omitted from the plan; the host's commit loop handles them via the existing skip path.
Dependency edges X depends on Y mean Y must commit before X. Two kinds of edges exist:
1. Containment: if Y is a folder being renamed and X.Original.FullPath is a descendant of Y.Original.FullPath, then Y must commit first; X's actual source is rebased onto Y.Preview.FullPath.
2. Path-shift: if X.Preview.FullPath equals Y.Original.FullPath, Y must move first to vacate the path X claims.

member.name: M:Mfr.Engine.CommitPlanner.Build(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{Mfr.Models.Rename.RenameItem})
member.summary: Builds a commit plan for the given rename items.
member.param: All rename items participating in the current preview pass.

member.name: M:Mfr.Engine.CommitPlanner._BuildDependencyEdges(System.Collections.Generic.IReadOnlyList{Mfr.Models.Rename.RenameItem})
member.summary: Builds a dependency graph over as a map of item → set of items that must commit before it.
member.param: All items that will be committed in this batch.
member.returns: A dictionary keyed by every participant; the value is the set of other participants whose commit must precede this item's commit. An empty set means the item has no prerequisites and is immediately eligible.

remarks.para: Two kinds of edge are recognised:

Containment: if other is a folder being renamed and subject.Original.FullPath is a descendant of other.Original.FullPath, then other must commit first so the folder is in its new location before the child is moved.
Path-shift: if subject.Preview.FullPath equals other.Original.FullPath, then other must vacate that path before subject can claim it.

member.name: T:Mfr.Engine.RenamePreviewFolderRebaser
member.summary: Rebases descendant items' preview directory paths so they follow ancestor folders being renamed in the same batch.

remarks.para: In this context, a "descendant item" means any item whose preview parent directory points to the renamed folder itself or a path under it.

Example: if folder A renames to A2 and file A\track.mp3 is also renamed to A\song.mp3 in the same batch, the file preview still starts under A. This helper rewrites the file item's Preview.DirectoryPath from A to A2 (and similarly for deeper paths). Without this rebase, a later file commit would either fail because the source path is no longer there or write to a stale location.
Only folder items whose preview path differs from the original participate as rebase sources. Items with preview errors are left alone so the conflict detector can still surface their state.
